chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 (1920x1080).
Subject: a lone tree silhouette on a hill under a star-dense night sky with a large Moon rising (an illustration, not a photograph).
Composition: tree on the left third, the Moon in the upper right third, wide empty negative space between.
Lighting and treatment: indigo night (#0B0F2A), silver Moon glow, faint teal horizon haze (#4FE3C6), soft bloom, subtle grain, shallow depth.
Mood: quiet wonder.
Text: "Look up." in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), lower-left, white.
Scientific accuracy: the Moon and stars are real objects; show a plausible, calm night sky and no impossible sizes.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news or NASA photo. It must read as a code-rendered illustration in the channel's look (indigo night #0B0F2A, teal #4FE3C6 light fronts, violet #5B3FD0).
Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
